name: housecall-pro
description: Ask your Housecall Pro account for what you need instead of clicking through reports.

hcp_api_key.title: Housecall Pro API key
hcp_api_key.description: In Housecall Pro: My Apps, then Go to App store, then API Key Management. Needs the MAX plan and an admin login. A read-only key works for reporting and lookups; writing needs a full-access one.

hcp_read_only.title: Read-only
hcp_read_only.description: Leave every tool that could change something in Housecall Pro out entirely. Independent of the key's own access level: the write tools are absent rather than merely refused.

hcp_toolsets.title: Toolsets
hcp_toolsets.description: Which groups of tools to load, comma-separated: company, customers, jobs, estimates, invoices, pricebook, schedule, reports, admin. Also 'all', and 'default' for the usual set. Loading fewer makes the assistant choose better among the ones that remain. Leave as 'default' for the usual set.
